rulings.restated: Input — Bound by the calling line (this person's Forms W-2, boxes 3 and 7).
rulings.model: The IRS line is "Total social security wages and tips (total of boxes 3 and 7 on Form(s) W-2) and railroad retirement (tier 1) compensation". The restatement leaves out railroad retirement (tier 1) compensation and has no refusal.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: refusal located elsewhere; restatement accepted. Railroad retirement (tier 1) compensation is refused for the whole return through person.rrta (the wage statements' RRTA question), which stops Schedule 3 line 11 (person.credit) and Form 8959 line 1 (person.medicare5); with it refused, line 8a is the Form W-2 boxes 3 and 7 total.
